state.batteryBody: So you never miss a ride, allow {{app}} to run without battery restrictions. Otherwise Android may doze the app and delay — or drop — the new-ride alert.
state.batteryTitle: Don't put the app to sleep
state.bgDisclosureBody:
{{app}} collects location data to offer you rides near you and to let support follow your trip if something goes wrong, even when the app is closed or not in use.

Sharing starts only when you go online, a notification tells you at all times that it is active, and it stops as soon as you go offline.
state.bgLocationBody: So {{app}} can show your route to support while you're on duty, allow "Always" location in settings. Without it, your position isn't shared in the background.
state.bgRequiredBody: To receive rides near you, {{app}} must track your location continuously ("Allow all the time" in settings). Turn it on to go online.
state.fsiBody: On Android 14 and later, allow full-screen display so new rides appear over the lock screen, like an incoming call. Without it, you'll only get a plain notification.
state.goingHomeCooldownBody: You've already used "Heading home" in the last 24 hours. It will be available again soon.
state.locationRequiredBody: {{app}} needs your location to put you online.
state.offlineBody: Go online to start receiving rides.
state.overlayBody: So new rides appear over other apps (like an incoming call), allow "Display over other apps" for {{app}}. Without it, a ride that arrives while you're using another app won't open the screen automatically.
